title: Fix cache and prediction misses in Target::qargs
notes: The PR documents a VF2Layout cache and branch-prediction regression that roughly doubled benchmark runtime without changing compiled-circuit behavior.

title: Accept rotation gate names in CommutationChecker filters
notes: The linked issue shows that filtered RX commutation checks returned False instead of True, which can drive incorrect commutation-based optimization decisions.

title: Fix incorrect global phase shift for P and U1 gates in CommutativeCancellation
notes: The linked issue and PR identify an erroneous π global-phase adjustment for P/U1 gates while the fix restores the intended phase.

title: Fix schedule analysis passes with empty circuits
notes: The linked issue reports that ASAP and ALAP schedule-analysis passes fail on empty circuits.

title: Avoid panics in Optimize1qGatesDecomposition
notes: The linked issue reports a PanicException in Optimize1qGatesDecomposition for an otherwise accepted circuit/backend configuration.

title: Fix pickling of SabreSwap
notes: The linked issue reports failure when SabreSwap is pickled for use by the parallel pass manager.

title: Un-provide standard_operation for PyGate
notes: The PR states that treating a controlled PyGate as a standard gate loses its control state, causing incorrect downstream circuit behavior.

title: Check target gates are parameterized in optimize1qgatesdecomposition
notes: The linked issue identifies that Optimize1qGatesDecomposition accepts target gates without checking arbitrary-angle support, risking an invalid decomposition.

title: Raise exception not panic on bad ConsolidateBlocks input
notes: The linked issue reports a panic in ConsolidateBlocks for a valid pass sequence, and the PR changes it to a handled exception.

title: Read timing constraints from target when no backend is provided
notes: The PR fixes preset-pass-manager scheduling so target timing constraints are applied rather than silently ignored.

title: Fix global cache of SynthesizeRZRotations
notes: The linked issue reports a panic from stale rsgridsynth cache entries when epsilon changes across SynthesizeRZRotations calls.

title: Fix non-deterministic ConsolidateBlocks output with fixed transpiler seed
notes: The PR explicitly fixes nondeterministic behavior in ConsolidateBlocks under the same compilation conditions.

title: Preserve global phase in Commuting2qGateRouter
notes: The PR explicitly corrects global-phase handling in Commuting2qGateRouter.

title: Fix excessive global-phase accumulation in UnrollForLoops
notes: The PR explicitly corrects accumulated global phase when UnrollForLoops expands loops.

title: Fix unsafe symmetric simplification of XXPlusYY in CommutativeOptimization
notes: The PR fixes an invalid simplification of XXPlusYY gates, which changes the synthesized circuit transformation.

title: Fix cancellation of CS and CSdg in InverseCancellation
notes: The PR fixes InverseCancellation behavior for symmetric gate pairs, preventing an unsafe cancellation transformation.

title: Fix forced ConsolidateBlocks decomposition for incomplete bases
notes: The PR fixes forced block consolidation when the basis is incomplete, preventing an invalid transformation under that basis.

title: Fix ParameterVector global-phase panic in RemoveIdentityEquivalent
notes: The PR title identifies a panic in RemoveIdentityEquivalent for a ParameterVector global-phase input.

title: Fix commutation checking between two Pauli product measurements
notes: The PR fixes an incorrect commutation result for Pauli-product measurements, which can make an optimizer apply unsafe transformations.

title: Fix synth_qft_line failure for circuits with 32 or more qubits
notes: The PR fixes synth_qft_line for circuits of 32 or more qubits, a boundary case associated with failure rather than an altered valid result.

title: Fix stale best-DAG update in C transpiler optimization level 3
notes: The PR repairs the level-3 optimization loop so the intended optimization process completes rather than returning a suboptimally optimized circuit.

title: Fix matrix-size validation in CommutationChecker
notes: The PR corrects the matrix-size guard in CommutationChecker so oversized operations do not enter an unnecessarily expensive matrix-based check.

title: Fix synth_clifford_depth_lnn for single-qubit Clifford circuits
notes: The linked issue reports a capacity-overflow PanicException for single-qubit Clifford synthesis.

title: Fix HLS qubit tracking for plugin-generated operations
notes: The PR explains that high-level synthesis restored the wrong ancilla-qubit state after recursion, which can change the resulting circuit.

title: Fix zero-length permutation synthesis overflow
notes: The PR states that zero-length permutation synthesis could overflow via subtraction.

title: Fix incorrect argument passed to generate_unroll_3q in Clifford+T transpilation
notes: The PR fixes an incorrect argument passed to generate_unroll_3q during Clifford+T transpilation, altering the synthesis transformation.

title: Respect Target when selecting a non-default UnitarySynthesis plugin
notes: The PR is a unitary-synthesis bug fix, indicating an incorrect synthesized circuit rather than a metadata-only defect.

title: Fix control-flow qargs handling in BasisTranslator
notes: The PR fixes incorrect ControlFlow block qarg mapping so local block qubits map to the correct original-circuit qubits.

title: Fix ConsolidateBlocks qubit mapping inside control-flow blocks
notes: The PR explains that missing hardware-qubit mapping in control-flow blocks caused ConsolidateBlocks to classify operations incorrectly.

title: Fix DAG push-edge ordering non-determinism
notes: The PR explicitly fixes edge-order nondeterminism during DAG node insertion and notes that broken transpiler determinism is significant.

title: Preserve registers through Python Layout to Rust TranspileLayout conversion
notes: The PR preserves registers in the output TranspileLayout, a layout-contract property rather than the layout-applied circuit unitary.

title: Fix global-phase handling in CommutativeCancellation
notes: The PR explicitly fixes global-phase handling in CommutativeCancellation.

title: Do not run VF2PostLayout when an explicit layout is supplied
notes: The PR restores VF2PostLayout calls after the O3 optimization loop, which affects the quality of the chosen layout rather than circuit semantics.

title: Fix Target.py_instruction_supported behavior
notes: The PR fixes Target instruction-support reporting; an incorrect support decision can route transpilation through the wrong transformation path.

title: Fix MCX dirty-ancilla qubit accounting in HLS selection
notes: The PR fixes two MCX synthesis plugins, indicating incorrect generated decompositions for affected inputs.

title: Fix CommutativeInverseCancellation for Clifford, control-flow, and non-invertible operations
notes: The linked issue reports that CommutativeInverseCancellation raises CircuitError for Initialize with complex parameters.

title: Fix ApplyLayout with empty layout
notes: The PR fixes ApplyLayout for an empty layout, an edge case that prevents successful pass execution.

title: Fix HLS classical-bit mapping from control-flow blocks
notes: The PR fixes classical-bit mapping in the HLS pass, which can produce a circuit with incorrectly wired classical behavior.

title: Fix alignment checks of stretch variables
notes: The linked issue reports a TranspilerError when compiling a circuit with stretch variables to a target with alignment constraints.

title: Fix subtraction-underflow panic in ConstrainedReschedule
notes: The PR and linked predecessor identify a subtraction-underflow panic that must be prevented.

title: Initialize ConstrainedReschedule.target unconditionally
notes: The linked issue reports an AttributeError when ConstrainedReschedule is constructed without a target.

title: Fix ConstrainedReschedule barrier handling
notes: The linked issue reports that ConstrainedReschedule raises an error when processing a barrier.

title: Add safe shape checking to synth_cz_depth_line_mr
notes: The linked issue reports a pyo3 PanicException for a badly shaped matrix passed to synth_cz_depth_line_mr.

title: Fix HighLevelSynthesis for custom gate calibrations
notes: The PR fixes HighLevelSynthesis handling of custom gate calibrations, which preserves a circuit-attached calibration contract rather than its unitary.
